subject: general
question: Which of the following Constitutional Amendment Act of the Indian Constitution deals with urban local bodies?
solution:
The correct answer is __**74th**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **74th Constitutional Amendment Act of 1992** deals with the provisions related to **urban local bodies** in India, such as Municipal Corporations, Municipal Councils, and Nagar Panchayats.
 
• It came into effect on **1st June 1993**.
 
• It introduced a new part, **Part IXA**, titled **“The Municipalities”**, in the Constitution.
 
• It fixed a term of **five years** for every urban local body, with elections to be held before the term expires.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **73rd Amendment Act**:

 
 
• Deals with **rural local bodies (Panchayati Raj Institutions)**, not urban local bodies.
 
• Introduced **Part IX** of the Constitution, covering the three-tier system of Panchayats.
 
• Came into effect on **24th April 1993**.
 
 
 
• **72nd Amendment Act**:
 
 
• Relates to the provisions for the **reservation of seats for Scheduled Tribes** in the Tripura Legislative Assembly.
 
• Came into effect in 1991.
 
 
 
• **75th Amendment Act**:
 
 
• Deals with provisions related to the **tenancy of properties** and added clauses to strengthen the **Rent Control Acts**.
 
• It empowered the **state legislatures** to make provisions for the **establishment of tribunals** for the adjudication of disputes related to **tenancy laws**, especially for properties covered under rent control legislation.
